items.hak: 識呀，佢係李偉雄。佢係吾表弟。其爸係吾大舅。

items.zh: 認識呀，他是李偉雄。他是我表弟。他爸是我的大舅舅。
items.en: Yes, he is Li Vui-hiung. He is my cousin. His dad is my eldest uncle.

items.zh: **第五調**和**第六調**是**入聲**，跟**第三調**、**第四調**的調值相似，符號都是一樣的。
items.en: **Tone 5** and **Tone 6** are **Entering Tones**. Their pitch values are similar to **Tone 3** and **Tone 4**, so the symbols used are the same.

items.zh: 客家話的**人稱代名詞****屬格**的變化，原理類似英語。{厓: ngai2}、{你: ngi2}、{佢: gi2}（= I, you, he/she） -> {吾: nga1}、{惹: ngia1}、{其: gia1}（= my, your, his/her）。
items.en: The change in Hakka **personal pronouns** for the **genitive case** is similar in principle to English. {厓: ngai2}, {你: ngi2}, {佢: gi2} (= I, you, he/she) -> {吾: nga1}, {惹: ngia1}, {其: gia1} (= my, your, his/her).

items.zh: 客家話的{{析}}（`săk`）是「邊」的意思。例如{左手析: zo3 siu3 sak5}、{右手析: yiu4 siu3 sak5}、{西瓜切做兩析: si1 ga1 | ciet6 zo4 | liong3 | sak5}。
items.en: In Hakka, {{析}} (`săk`) means 'side'. For example: 'left side' ({左手析: zo3 siu3 sak5}), 'right side' ({右手析: yiu4 siu3 sak5}), 'cut the watermelon into two halves' ({西瓜切做兩析: si1 ga1 | ciet6 zo4 | liong3 | sak5}).

items.zh: 香港客家話區分「舅父」比媽媽大還是小，哥哥是{大舅: tai4 kiu1}、弟弟是{舅仔: kiu1 zai3}。
items.en: Hong Kong Hakka distinguishes whether a 'maternal uncle' is older or younger than one's mother. The older brother is {大舅: tai4 kiu1}, and the younger brother is {舅仔: kiu1 zai3}.

items.zh: {{幾}}在發問，或者意思是「甚為」的時候，發音是 `gĭt`，例如{幾多: git5 do1}、{幾時: git5 si3}、{幾好看: git5 hau3 kon4}、{幾聰明: git5 | cung1 min2}。另外也有 `gĭ` 的發音，詳見第六課。
items.en: When {{幾}} is used in questions or means 'how/very', it is pronounced `gĭt`. For example: 'how many' ({幾多: git5 do1}), 'when' ({幾時: git5 si3}), 'how nice' ({幾好看: git5 hau3 kon4}), 'how clever' ({幾聰明: git5 | cung1 min2}). There is also the pronunciation `gĭ`, detailed in Lesson 6.

items.zh: {你幾多姊妹: ngi2 | git5 do1 | zi3 moi4}是連同自己計算的，是你父母有多少個孩子的意思。傳統客家話不說「兄弟姊妹」，只說{姊妹: zi3 moi4}。
items.en: '{你幾多姊妹: ngi2 | git5 do1 | zi3 moi4}' ('How many siblings do you have?') includes yourself in the count; it asks how many children your parents have. Traditional Hakka says {姊妹: zi3 moi4} ('sisters/siblings') instead of 「兄弟姊妹」 ('brothers and sisters').
